input: Scheduled routine: continue work on the repo aiming to develop, deploy, market, sell and support revenue generating software products; merge when done.

doc_friction.issue: said Python de-stuffing was 'about half of a tile's time'; measured at about 8% (0.10 ms of ~1.25 ms). The real limits were the numpy prediction pass and per-tile table builds (the Pixel writes new Huffman tables per tile). Corrected in eval/native-destuff-2026-11-13.md.

deviations.why: Default route drew the research track; the scheduled routine's own message asks for revenue/venture work, so I routed with --task as prompt.md allows
The named item (de-stuffing into C) alone gave under 10%, so I widened the slice to the whole tile decode (12-bit table, C prediction)
deviations.did: moved the full tile decode into C
deviations.result: Pixel read about 2x faster on 4 CPUs, same sensels

notes: Pixel 3 XL DNG parse_raw, 3 alternating runs before/after: 4 threads best 0.207-0.218 s -> 0.091-0.107 s; 1 thread 0.320-0.349 -> 0.214-0.217. 0 of 12,192,768 sensels differ from LibRaw; sensel SHA unchanged. tests/test_ljpeg_native.py + test_ljpeg_fast.py: 31 passed, 1725 subtests (venv with numpy, rawpy). Full photo-editing suite: 893 passed, 6 skipped, 2168 subtests (94 s).
